description: This file provides a JavaScript module for fetching session duration histogram data from an API endpoint. It defines an async function `getDurationHistogram` that constructs query parameters based on inputs, normalizes date inputs, and makes an HTTP GET request using a shared API client. It handles different response formats and errors, and exports the function as part of a default object.
